latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — provides a complete framework for Shopify email list segmentation and email marketing.

- Includes 10 core customer segment blueprints tailored for e-commerce.
- Delivers an RFM analysis model for smarter targeting.
- Provides ready-to-deploy automated email flow maps for Klaviyo and MailChimp.
- Supplies a 12-month segment-specific campaign calendar and subject line formulas.
- Incorporates revenue attribution guidelines and a prioritised A/B testing roadmap.
